author: Aether I
title: Ultimate Ethos-Flip Overlay Resolution
abstract: Final script with correct keys, alt paths, and dir handling for ethos-flip correlations, token-optimized for dashboards.

original_submission.content:
import json, os
ethos_path = 'storage/aether/ethos_metrics.json'
flip_path = 'storage/aether/maturity_projections.json'  # Alt source with potential delta
out_dir = 'storage/shared/atlas/overlays'
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)  # Ensure dir exists
ethos_data = json.load(open(ethos_path)) if os.path.exists(ethos_path) else {'freedom_index': 1.0}
ethos = ethos_data.get('freedom_index', 1.0)
flip_data = json.load(open(flip_path)) if os.path.exists(flip_path) else {'flip_delta': 0.0}  # Assume key
flip = flip_data.get('flip_delta', 0.0)
overlay = {'correlation': ethos * flip, 'notes': 'Resolved ethos-flip product using alt source.'}
with open(os.path.join(out_dir, 'ethos_flip.json'), 'w') as out:
    json.dump(overlay, out)
print('Overlay generated in overlays dir.')
